remarks: Heights Crossing, Darien's premier new development, offers luxury living with immediate access to NYC via the Noroton Heights train station just across the street. This third-floor 1BR + office, 1.5 bath residence features a Juliet balcony off the living room. Interior finishes include GE Monogram appliances, custom cabinetry, quartz countertops with seated island, and wood-style luxury vinyl plank flooring throughout. Open-concept layout with eat-in kitchen, half bath, and in-unit washer/dryer. Spacious en-suite bedroom with dual walk-in closets and stall shower. Enhanced sound mitigation between floors and exterior foam insulation. Secure access building with garage parking, elevator, on-site management, fitness center, golf simulator, co-working spaces, resident lounge, bicycle storage, and package/mailroom.  Pet restrictions, please ask. Model units available to tour soon, restrictions apply, please inquire. Photos represent model units, individual unit will vary. Representation of quality only, not actual unit.
